coverage_gaps: Citation-graph and DOI metadata routes are unavailable, so backward and forward citation expansion must be approximated through PubMed identifiers, titles, authors, and linked-publication metadata.
Non-FDA regulators and non-US label histories are outside the available routes, limiting jurisdictional comparison.
Additional bibliographic indexes, preprint servers, and claims or electronic-health-record databases are unavailable, which may reduce recall for recent or non-PubMed conflicting evidence.
ClinicalTrials.gov may expose only the current record and available history; inaccessible historical versions would limit reconstruction of registry changes.
exclusion_criteria: Animal, in vitro, or mechanistic-only studies without decision-relevant human safety outcomes.
Tofacitinib studies confined to diseases other than rheumatoid arthritis unless they directly explain an FDA action applicable to marketed rheumatoid arthritis use.
Efficacy-only reports that provide no usable cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, or overall serious-safety information.
Narrative commentary that neither contributes primary data nor materially clarifies study design, evidence conflict, regulatory interpretation, or publication status.
Duplicate citations representing the same canonical record; retain every query-to-record link while screening the canonical record once.
Records first published, issued, or updated after 2024-12-31.
inclusion_criteria: Human evidence concerning marketed tofacitinib exposure in adults with rheumatoid arthritis and reporting cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, or mortality outcomes.
The pivotal postauthorization safety study registry record, its results history, primary publication, linked secondary analyses, and publication-status notices.
FDA safety communications, review materials, and labeling actions that concern tofacitinib safety and were issued or effective on or before 2024-12-31.
Comparative randomized, observational, registry, or meta-analytic evidence that can qualify or challenge the pivotal study findings in rheumatoid arthritis.
Records published online, issued, or updated on or before 2024-12-31, with online-first, issue, registry-update, and regulatory effective dates retained separately.
English-language records or records with an English abstract sufficient to determine eligibility and route the full record for assessment.

queries.purpose: Recover the primary publication and PubMed-indexed anchor records for the pivotal safety study.
queries.query: ("Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover the canonical registry record, study design, prespecified outcomes, results, sponsor identifiers, and linked publications.
Recover FDA materials explicitly tied to the postauthorization study.
queries.query: tofacitinib ORAL Surveillance NCT02092467 rheumatoid arthritis safety

queries.purpose: Discover broad human safety evidence for marketed tofacitinib in rheumatoid arthritis.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690550"[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690,550"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR adverse[Title/Abstract] OR risk[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm cardiovascular findings, definitions, absolute and relative estimates, and relevant subgroup qualifications.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular events"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR myocardial infarction[Title/Abstract] OR stroke[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm malignancy findings and cancer-type or risk-factor qualifications.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract] OR "lung cancer"[Title/Abstract] OR "nonmelanoma skin cancer"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm venous and arterial thrombotic findings, including dose-related signals.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR VTE[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR "deep vein thrombosis"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm all-cause and cause-specific mortality evidence.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract] OR fatal*[Title/Abstract] OR "all-cause mortality"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Cross-check registry identity, interventions, comparator, outcome definitions, enrollment, completion, results, and publication links.
queries.query: AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND AREA[ConditionSearch]"Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND AREA[InterventionSearch]tofacitinib AND (AREA[OtherTerms]NCT02092467 OR AREA[OtherTerms]"ORAL Surveillance")

queries.purpose: Recover FDA safety communications, labeling actions, boxed-warning language, affected populations, and effective dates.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz boxed warning serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death rheumatoid arthritis

queries.purpose: Trace earlier and later FDA thrombosis and mortality actions and distinguish interim signals from final regulatory conclusions.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz pulmonary embolism thrombosis mortality postmarketing requirement safety trial label history

queries.purpose: Find secondary analyses that qualify risk by dose, age, smoking, baseline cardiovascular risk, or other effect modifiers.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR A3921133[Title/Abstract]) AND (subgroup[Title/Abstract] OR biomarker[Title/Abstract] OR smoking[Title/Abstract] OR age[Title/Abstract] OR "cardiovascular risk"[Title/Abstract] OR dose[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Seek qualifying or conflicting comparative evidence and explain differences in population, comparator, exposure, follow-up, and outcome ascertainment.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR "real world"[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR meta-analysis[Title/Abstract])) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify corrections, retractions, expressions of concern, and linked notices that could alter evidence handling.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR erratum[Title] OR correction[Title] OR retract*[Title/Abstract] OR "expression of concern"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Check whether FDA communications or labels were corrected, superseded, withdrawn, or materially revised.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz correction withdrawal recall safety communication label revision retraction

queries.purpose: Capture late publications and publication-status updates through the as-of cutoff.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title] OR retract*[Title/Abstract]) AND ("2023/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Safety frame: among adults with rheumatoid arthritis receiving marketed tofacitinib, especially patients aged 50 years or older with cardiovascular risk factors, assess through 2024-12-31 the comparative risks of major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality versus tumor necrosis factor inhibitors; link the pivotal postauthorization study across registry, primary publication, and FDA actions; identify qualifying or conflicting evidence and corrections, retractions, or other publication-status changes that affect evidence handling.
stop_rules: Complete all planned query events across pubmed, clinicaltrials_gov, and fda_regulatory through the 2024-12-31 cutoff.
Recover and identity-match the NCT02092467 registry record, the primary ORAL Surveillance publication, and the FDA actions based on the study before stopping.
Verify that each of the four outcomes—cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality—has completed confirmation screening or is explicitly documented as an evidence gap.
Complete the challenge searches for qualifying or conflicting evidence and for correction, retraction, expression-of-concern, withdrawal, and supersession status.
Stop expansion after two consecutive eligible expansion passes add no new decision-relevant canonical evidence or study-to-registry-to-regulatory links.
Stop at 16 query events and report any unfinished route, outcome, or publication-status check as budget exhaustion in coverage gaps.
Do not stop solely because the pivotal anchors are recovered; stopping also requires completion of temporal-update queries through the as-of date.
